notes.title: 3..2..1..Grenades! Update 1.01!!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! Just wanted to let you all know that I've pushed an update for 321!! This update includes some bug fixes, and even better... a whole new map!

Updates
- A new map! Ice Cave

A Wide open map with lots of levels. Take the elevators to the top or the quick route, through one of the Teleporters inside the house.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/krfiPJ5.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BRFM3qM.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/nKhJsUV.png[/img]

Fixes 
- Achievements should be fixed.
- Bug where you could randomly fall through the level geometry is fixed.
- Inverted aim
- Camera overlay when you're dead doesn't show black bar.
- Settings menu navigation order was messed up when using keyboard.
-
